roles.name: test-infrastructure
roles.description: Test fixtures, mocks, helper classes, and test data that support testing other components.

roles.name: cli-interface
roles.description: Command-line interface handlers that parse arguments, coordinate operations, and format output for human users.

roles.name: config-management
roles.description: Configuration loading, validation, and data structures for project settings and runtime parameters.

roles.name: source-parsing
roles.description: Source code analysis that extracts symbols, references, and structural information from Python files using tree-sitter.

roles.name: graph-database
roles.description: SQLite-backed storage layer that persists symbols, references, and metadata with query capabilities.

roles.name: llm-client
roles.description: Language model integration including prompt construction, response handling, token counting, and retry logic.

roles.name: documentation-sync
roles.description: Core documentation generation pipeline that creates and updates triefact files by coordinating parsing, LLM calls, and file writing.

roles.name: change-detection
roles.description: Freshness tracking and cascade analysis that determines which files need regeneration when source code changes.

roles.name: mcp-server
roles.description: Model Context Protocol server implementation that exposes trie's capabilities to AI coding agents via stdio.

roles.name: agent-integration
roles.description: Installation and configuration utilities for integrating trie with AI coding environments and IDEs.

roles.name: code-editing
roles.description: Patch application pipeline that uses LLM inference to edit source code and update documentation based on implementation notes.

roles.name: monitoring-telemetry
roles.description: Telemetry collection, audit trail generation, and operational monitoring for debugging and cost tracking.
